arguments.where: id IN (SELECT id FROM failed_jobs WHERE status = 'malformed' LIMIT 47)

arguments.summary: The failed jobs backlog was due to 47 malformed rows blocking the retry queue. These rows have been deleted, unblocking the queue. The backlog is now being processed.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the retry queue and failed_jobs table to ensure that the issue does not recur. Investigate the cause of the malformed rows to prevent future failures.
